# batch-table: `BatchOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout batch MEASURE INPUTS… --json` and `openreadout stats|trace|table|info FILES… --tidy --json` (also `analyze gate`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of a batch command in table mode.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/batch-table.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/batch-table.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema batch-table`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `measure` | `string` | yes | Measure (`stats`, `trace`, `table`, `gate`, `info`, …). |
| `grain` | array of `string` | yes | Columns that identify a row within its data set. |
| `inputs` | [`InputReport`](#inputreport) | yes | How the inputs became data sets. |
| `joins` | array of [`JoinReport`](#joinreport) |  | Sample sheets and layouts joined, in order. |
| `columns` | array of [`Column`](#column) | yes | Columns of `rows`, with type, unit and role (`id`, `key`, `metadata`, `annotation`, `value`, `error`). |
| `total_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows in the whole table. |
| `offset` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Index of the first row in `rows`. |
| `returned_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows returned here. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when the table has rows after the last one returned (page with `offset`, or read the full table from `output`). |
| `rows` | array of array of [`Value`](#value) | yes | Rows as arrays in column order. |
| `summary` | [`SummaryOutput`](#summaryoutput) or `null` |  | The group summary (`--by`). |
| `output` | [`WrittenFile`](#writtenfile) or `null` |  | The file the full table was written to (`-o`). |
| `warnings` | array of `string` |  | Things to check: skipped inputs, grouping, join results. |

## Types

### InputReport

How the inputs turned into data sets.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `datasets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets measured (rows come from these), including those that failed. |
| `ok` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets measured without error. |
| `failed` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets that failed (their rows carry `error`). |
| `skipped_unknown` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Files found by walking a directory that no reader recognises (not in the table). |
| `skipped_format` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets of other formats left out by the format filter. |
| `skipped_sheets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Sample sheets and layouts found among the inputs (never measured). |
| `grouped_members` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Files that belong to another input's multi-file data set (measured once, with it). |
| `skipped_examples` | array of `string` |  | A few of the skipped paths, with why. |
| `reused` | `integer` (uint64) |  | Data sets whose rows were reused from the journal of an interrupted run. |

### JoinReport

What a join did.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet` | [`SampleSheet`](#samplesheet) | yes | The sheet read. |
| `key` | array of [`KeyCandidate`](#keycandidate) | yes | The key used: one or more (sheet column, field) pairs, all of which must agree. |
| `auto` | `boolean` | yes | True when the key was chosen from the data (no `--key`). |
| `alternatives` | array of [`KeyCandidate`](#keycandidate) |  | The next best keys (auto only), to judge how clear the choice was. |
| `annotations` | array of `string` | yes | Columns added to the table. |
| `matched_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Table rows that got annotations. |
| `rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows in the table. |
| `matched_datasets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets with at least one annotated row. |
| `datasets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets in the table. |
| `unmatched_datasets` | array of `string` | yes | Data sets no sheet row matched (first 20). |
| `unmatched_datasets_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many data sets no sheet row matched. |
| `unmatched_sheet_rows` | array of `string` | yes | Sheet rows that matched no table row, by their key values (first 20). |
| `unmatched_sheet_rows_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many sheet rows matched nothing. |
| `ambiguous` | array of `string` | yes | Table rows that matched several sheet rows that disagree (first 20); left without annotations. |
| `ambiguous_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | How many rows were ambiguous. |
| `warnings` | array of `string` |  | Things to check. |

### SampleSheet

A sample sheet or plate layout in long form.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The file. |
| `worksheet` | `string` or `null` |  | Worksheet read (workbooks only). |
| `kind` | [`SheetKind`](#sheetkind) | yes | Table or plate layout. |
| `columns` | array of `string` | yes | Column names (a layout: `well`, then one per grid). |
| `plate_wells` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Plate format of a layout (96, 384, 1536, …). |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | What was assumed while reading. |

### SheetKind

How the sheet was laid out.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"table"` | A header row, one row per sample. |
| `"plate_layout"` | Plate-shaped grids, one per annotation, turned into one row per well. |

### KeyCandidate

One key pair tried.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_column` | `string` | yes | Sheet column. |
| `field` | [`KeyField`](#keyfield) | yes | Table key. |
| `matched_rows` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Table rows it matches. |
| `matched_datasets` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Data sets it matches. |

### KeyField

A key of the table's rows a sheet column can match.

Type: `"path"` | `"file"` | `"stem"` | `"sample_id"` | `"sample_name"` | `"barcode"` | `"well"` | `"position"` | `"run_order"` | object.

### Column

One column.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name (stable; units that never change are part of it, e.g. `sample_rate_hz`). |
| `type` | [`ColumnType`](#columntype) | yes | Inferred type. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of every value in the column, when fixed. |
| `role` | [`Role`](#role) | yes | What the column holds. |
| `description` | `string` or `null` |  | One line on its meaning. |

### ColumnType

Column type, inferred from the cells.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"string"` | Text. |
| `"integer"` | Whole numbers. |
| `"float"` | Real numbers (a column mixing integers and reals is `float`). |
| `"boolean"` | `true`/`false`. |

### Role

What a column holds.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"id"` | Which data set a row comes from: `path`, `format`, `files`. |
| `"key"` | The row's position within its data set (the measure's grain): `channel`, `population`, `well`, `parameter`, … |
| `"annotation"` | Joined from a sample sheet or plate layout. |
| `"metadata"` | Recorded in the file's own metadata (sample id, well, instrument). |
| `"value"` | A measured or computed value. |
| `"error"` | `error`, `error_code`. |

### Value

One cell.

Type: `boolean` | `integer` (int64) | `number` (double) | `string` or `null`.

### TableFormat

A table file format.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"csv"` | Comma-separated values with a header row. |
| `"tsv"` | Tab-separated values with a header row. |
| `"jsonl"` | One JSON object per row and line. |
| `"json"` | `{"columns": [...], "rows": [[...], ...]}`. |
| `"parquet"` | Apache Parquet (Snappy), with column metadata. |
